name: ITQlick

sources.title: ITQlick homepage — 24,658+ business software & AI tools comparison
About — 'not by accepting payment for placement'; vendors pay only on buyer connections
Third-party listing guide — manual listing management for vendors
Third-party report describing itqlick as a paid dofollow listing

conditions: Vendors can list products on the ITQlick marketplace and create a portfolio, but the public vendor-signup path is not clearly documented — account/contact required
Monetization is lead-gen: 'we're paid by vendors only when we help connect them with the right buyer' — listings may be free while vendor leads cost money
Third-party sources conflict: one reports it as a paid dofollow listing, the About page says placement cannot be bought
requirements: Business software product (B2B categories: accounting, CRM, PM, HR, VoIP, AI tools etc.)
Listings are evaluated against structured criteria: pricing transparency, feature depth, vendor stability, user limits, integration support
Vendor must be willing to maintain/claim a manual listing (no sync support per myPresences)
preparation: Company and product details: name, description, category, pricing info, features, screenshots/logo
Published pricing data — their scoring tracks public pricing transparency
Vendor contact email (info@ITQlick.com is the published corporate contact)
workflow: Search itqlick.com for your product — it may already exist in their 24,658+ product database
If absent, contact info@ITQlick.com or locate the vendor/marketplace signup to add the product
If present, claim/manage the listing manually and enrich the profile
Listing is scored 0-100 under their methodology and shown in category comparisons
watchFor: Homepage/product pages 403 to automated fetches — JS/bot protection; use a real browser
Conflicting third-party claims about whether a paid listing exists — the site's own line is 'we do not accept payment for placement'
Vendor monetization is lead-based; expect outreach about lead-gen packages once listed
No public vendor-submission URL verified at retrieval
countsAsLive: A product profile page on itqlick.com with a score, appearing in its category's comparison lists
unknowns: Whether a listing itself costs anything vs only lead connections
Whether outbound vendor links are dofollow
